facts.fact: Fragon 当众爆料（「Are you going to tell Draven how you told our commander you loved her?…she cuffed your ass?」）——Draven 血速一拳放倒 Lucan（鼻血横流、全院静止）；「The only reason you are alive…Arkendrath would find itself at war with another. Cadmar doesn't fuck around with treaties」——护她宣言（「If anyone so much as breathes in her direction in a way she doesn't welcome…I will handle it for her」）
facts.anchor: Draven’s blood-gifted punch lands before we can process the speed of the movement.

facts.fact: 首次公开吻：他当众吻她（「If his words didn't claim me, there is no doubt now who I exist for」）；部下与 Sea Guard 混编拔刃对峙 Lucan 的 men——「Fucking Fragon—starting wars」
facts.anchor: I would not do that to the family of my Marked Match.”

facts.fact: 夜谈：处决的数学（「half the Guard will follow me」vs「There would be another Sunder within Arkendrath」）；她已劝 Eirene「拿我做例子保全新政」；他的进化被她点名（「When we met, you didn't believe women should be at risk…Now you think people are fickle」）——「I told you the night of the Brinden Ball that I would build a world where you can be anything you want to be.」
facts.anchor: There would be another Sunder within Arkendrath.”

facts.fact: Darvic 解密倒计时：「I will say it over, and over, and over again until the day I die. Tal Pondre Minak, Lavina.」——她用指节敲他鼻尖打节奏回「I. Love. You」；「You make me complete…Thank you, Lavina Theron, for loving the man」——「I didn't need to be harder to break—I needed the person for me.」

他的战争承诺：「my men and I are highly trained…we will wage a war so terrifying, it will make the one held with Dranderon look like a low-level Guard training exercise. If they threaten harm to the woman I am Marked to, I will fucking kill them all—all of them.」
facts.anchor: we will wage a war so terrifying

facts.fact: 石头隐喻收束：她问「人能成为另一个人的 Brinden Stone 吗？」——「Then you also get to be my new Brinden Stone. Now that I have you, I don't need another.」——「And you are quite the artifact, too.」
facts.anchor: Then you also get to be my new Brinden Stone.
